source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_edges = [-1, *divider_rows, h]
    col_edges = [-1, *divider_cols, w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1) if row_edges[i + 1] > row_edges[i] + 1]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1) if col_edges[i + 1] > col_edges[i] + 1]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_spans for r in range(r0, r1) for c0, c1 in col_spans for c in range(c0, c1)]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    output = [[background for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2:
                output[i][j] = 1
    return output
